This one is a TOTAL showstopper 😍✨ Say hello to this GORGEOUS, cozy, weighted beauty made with a full Double Crochet stitch… but you KNOW I couldn’t stop there! I started with 32 beginning loops and worked up this dreamy blanket using 14 skeins, reaching a comfy 49x60”. And let me tell you… this yarn is EVERYTHING 🙌 I used Mello Bello yarn, and it is SO easy to work with—smooth, soft, and just glides through your hands like a dream! But was I done? Oh no… not even close 😏 I added a DOUBLE CROCHET border (because more texture = more magic), bringing it to 53x60”… and then decided it STILL needed that extra touch of cozy perfection 💁‍♀️ So YES… I finished it off with an additional single crochet border, landing at a final size of 56x62” using 18 skeins total! The color combo?! ✨ Soft grey ✨ Light pink ✨ Off white = PURE WOW 🤍🌸 This blanket has that perfect weighted feel, incredible texture, and wraps you up like a warm hug! And guess what… I’ve got you covered 🙌 🎥 FULL tutorial is on my YouTube channel: holymolydane Now tell me… What do YOU think of this one?! 😍  #holymolydane #fyp #chunkyknitblanket #mellobello @MelloBello
